program.name: Bell Weekend
program.subject: Busy week
program.blurb: One kettlebell and one longer session: a bell circuit one day, a bell EMOM the next.
program.about: One kettlebell and the one longer session the week allows. One day is a circuit of swings, squats, presses and core work, round after round; the other is an EMOM of the same kind of moves. Nothing else needed. Abs finish every session. Level II asks for a heavier bell and Level III adds reps.
program.split: Long bell circuit / long bell EMOM
